kind.never: over-claim at ANY scope; no gate or hedge rescues it; the scanner fails on any match
kind.gated: allowed ONLY when the named claim-gates.ts function returns true; otherwise the hedge copy must be used
kind.test_gated: no runtime flag; allowed only when the listed test anchors exist AND pass (CI), else hedge
kind.allowed: honest now; listed so the scanner does not flag it (negative control)
kind.hedge_required: no runtime gate exists; a match passes ONLY if the same line carries one of hedge_phrases
kind.caveat_required: a match passes ONLY if the same FILE carries one of required_caveat (W4 timing caveat)

how_to_read.detector: name of an existing function exported by pq_overclaim.cjs (port it, don't duplicate)
how_to_read.patterns: case-insensitive JS regex sources, matched against normalized (lowercased, whitespace-collapsed) copy
how_to_read.examples: over = must be flagged, ok = must NOT be flagged; validate_registry.cjs enforces both
how_to_read.gate_value_at_sha: value returned on svrnty main at grounded_at; a flipper updates claim-gates.test.ts AND this field
how_to_read.hedge_phrases: regex array; for gated rows a same-line hedge excuses a match while the gate is false; THIS row's phrases only, never any hedge-ish word
how_to_read.disclaimer_phrases: NEVER rows only: a same-line honest negation listed here passes; NO annotation or free-text excuse ever rescues a NEVER match
how_to_read.requires: test_gated: [{file, test, invariant, resolved}]; resolved=false means the anchor is not yet named in a real test file
how_to_read.scan_root: A = svrnty src/ + app/ (svrnty CI); B = autobots infra/satellite/*.html (svrnty_deploy pre-deploy). A run asserts its OWN root or exits 2.
how_to_read.sweep_gate_override: if present, the sweep uses THIS boolean instead of the claim-gates.ts value (a gate that is true without the capability being real must not excuse a claim)
how_to_read.console_excluded: console.* and logger calls are not user copy; the sweep skips them for every row (Archie lane:svrnty #56)
how_to_read.annotations: `// claim-sweep:ok <reason>` is honored ONLY for gated / test_gated / hedge_required rows, must carry a reason, and every honored one is printed (count + file:line). Never for NEVER or caveat_required.
